findings.evidence: The declarations rewrite mapped-real, negated, and entrywise-conjugated Hermitian signatures to simpler expressions, but only `signature_zero` at line 116 is annotated.
findings.fix: Add `@[simp]` to these terminating signature normalization lemmas.
findings.issue: Normal-form lemmas `signature_map_ofReal` (line 108), `signature_neg` (122), and `signature_map_starRingEnd` (130) lack `@[simp]`; notably the parallel real `Matrix.signature_neg` is already a simp lemma.

findings.evidence: Lines 157–158 reduce the new invariant at `-1` to `Matrix.signature`; lines 197–198 reduce the mirror operation to integer negation.
findings.issue: The characteristic special-value lemma `tristramLevineSignature_neg_one` and mirror normalization `tristramLevineSignature_neg_transpose` at line 197 lack `@[simp]`, although the corresponding value at `1` and conjugation rules are simp lemmas.

summary: Several canonical normalization lemmas are missing `@[simp]`, leaving the new signature API inconsistent with the existing real-signature API.
